$comment: Product-claim lint (doc 06 §3.7 L-14 / D-15a, §4.3; ENG-10). Seeds: doc 03 §1.4 + §3.8 CLAIM_SEED, doc 08 §1.1 red lines and §7.5 banned phrases, F11/F14/F16, R26, R28, R40, R41, R45, H13.
patterns: regex sources per locale code; '*' applies to every locale. Matched case-insensitively against each leaf value with placeholders filled and markup stripped.

exempt: key paths (wildcards: [*] / .*; a path also covers its subtree) where the phrase is allowed, e.g. the negative FAQ answers. exemptPrefix: key-path prefixes. only: the rule applies only under these key paths.
A published locale with neither its own patterns nor '*' patterns for a rule gets a W 'not covered' (L-14) so reviewers check it by hand (R36).
When a translator delivers a locale, add its wording to every rule (doc 08 §7.5).
